title: The Jewel of Medina
author: Sherry Jones
current_text: The government banned The Jewel of Medina in Malaysia in 2009.

sources.quote: The government banned 22 books in 2009, at least three due to religious content: The Jewel of Medina, The Trouble with Islam Today, and Ibrahim and Sarah.
sources.title: 2010 Report on International Religious Freedom - Malaysia | Refworld

ban_rows.note: Banned in Malaysia by the Ministry of Home Affairs (KDN) under the Printing Presses and Publications Act. Gazetted 2009-07-30 (P.U. (A) 271). Publisher: Beaufort Books, New York. Printer: Dicetak di Amerika Syarikat. Language: INGGERIS.
